Answer the following questions together with your client.


ATTENTION! The information requested herein is based on Article 52 of the General Provisions applicable to Credit Institutions, in order to verify whether a person or group represents a common risk.


Clients are hereby warned that by signing this “form”, they may be subject to sanctions if they provide false information with the intent to obtain financing, as such acts are considered offenses under Articles 112 Bis and 112 Septimus of the Credit Institutions Law.
